name: Annapolis public bid board
note: Hourly public-listing scan; relevant detail pages are checked before importing notices.

name: Danville public bid board
note: Hourly public-listing scan; responder lists, bid tabs and conflicting statuses are not treated as open bids.

name: Maryland eMMA
note: Official statewide procurement portal. Automated ingestion is not connected. Search and review current solicitations on the portal. County-owned feeds and boards add partial coverage; full statewide access remains unresolved.

name: Virginia eVA
note: Official statewide procurement gateway. Automated ingestion is not connected. The Open Data page describes historical procurement data, not a verified live bid feed. The approved alternative implemented here is collection from issuer-owned mirrors (UOSA and Salem), not an authenticated statewide scrape.

name: Anne Arundel County / Harbor
note: Use Bid Opportunities (Harbor) on this county page. Harbor replaced the previous system for solicitations after July 6, 2026. No automated ingestion is connected. Official viewing guide requires Harbor login and MFA; no sanctioned public feed was identified. Municipal sources are not a substitute for county-wide coverage.

name: D.C. OCP public solicitations
note: Public portal search and environmental notice details checked hourly. Coverage is limited to notices returned by OCP; independent agencies may publish elsewhere.

name: Warrenton public bid board
note: Hourly public-listing scan; no relevant invitations are inferred from an empty board.

name: Frederick County public bid board
note: Checks this public board only. County links to other procurement platforms are not included.

name: Lynchburg public bid board
note: Hourly public-listing scan; relevant notices and amendments require official review.

name: Franklin County public bid board
note: Hourly public-listing scan; unrelated notices are excluded.

name: Harford County official open opportunities
note: Checks the official county open-opportunity listing and its stated closing times. Full Bonfire documents and amendments require bidder review.

name: Caroline County public bid board
note: Checks relevant notices on this county board; not statewide coverage.

name: Fredericksburg public bid board
note: Checks relevant notices on the public city board; unrelated notices are excluded.

name: Loudoun County public bid board
note: Hourly public board scan, including source-stated amendments and document references. Full attachments require bidder review.

name: Wicomico County public bid board
note: Hourly scan of this board. An empty board does not establish that no county opportunities exist on other platforms.

name: Hampton public bid board
note: Hourly scan of environmental titles on this board. Other purchasing platforms and unrelated construction are outside coverage.

name: EPA national Brownfields selection discovery
note: Daily discovery from the current-year national selection table linked by EPA. Funding selections remain early signals; no open bidding opportunity is inferred.

name: Montgomery County official active-solicitation feed
note: Hourly read of the official active-solicitation open-data API. Date-only closing fields never establish verified open-bid status.

name: Upper Occoquan Service Authority solicitations
note: Hourly public authority mirror of its eVA solicitations. Only the current table is scanned; expired dates remain closed.

name: Salem public bid board
note: Hourly official bid-board scan, with explicit receipt deadlines from source prose when the summary closing field is generic.

name: Town of La Plata public bid board
note: Hourly town-owned listing scan; this does not replace eMMA coverage.

name: Queen Anne’s County public bid board
note: Hourly official county listing scan; only relevant environmental titles are followed.
